question: What capacity arises in the disciple once a divine state has been born in him?
premises: A divine state has arisen in the disciple.
This transformed state confers a new capacity.
The disciple comes to know all.
inference: The disciple in whom a divine state has arisen knows all.
uncertainties: The scope of 'sarvaṃ' (all) may be doctrinally qualified.
plain_english: O Śāmbhavī, he in whom the divine state has arisen knows everything.
